Keep Moisturiser ready for face yoga practice. A mat is also needed for the practice
To practice such classes on a daily basis, join our daily yoga classes on the Satvic App:
Face Yoga for Natural Glow & Facial Relaxation
Our face goes through a lot every day. We smile, worry, laugh, think, talk, and sometimes hold a lot of tension without even knowing it.
Just like we move our body to feel better, we can also give some love and movement to our face.
Gentle face yoga and massage can help us relax the muscles of the face, jaw, and neck and bring more awareness to how we are holding tension.
